style: Cinematic illustrated 2D urban storybook, clean black contours, warm amber and cool blue accents, consistent realistic perspective. No anime redesign. 16:9.
character: Same iconic protagonist: pale minimal face with two oval eyes, messy short dark hair, oversized orange headphones, teal hoodie and dark trousers. Never normal-detailed face for protagonist.
supporting: Background supporting people may have ordinary stylized eyes, nose and mouth; never copy protagonist's minimal facial design or bright teal/orange outfit.

scenes.beat: Every notification feels urgent. A friend needs a favor. A client wants a quick answer. So you reply, even when you're exhausted.
scenes.action: Slumped, holding smartphone in left hand, other hand at temple

scenes.beat: Soon you're checking your phone everywhere, afraid that taking too long to respond might disappoint someone.
But being reachable every minute can quietly turn your time into something people expect rather than appreciate.
scenes.action: Sits apart, gazing at untouched cup, phone face down on table

scenes.beat: The change begins when you put the phone down. You don't have to explain every moment of silence.
scenes.action: Calmly looks over skyline with BOTH hands in hoodie pockets
required: phone lying on parapet away from hands

scenes.beat: Decide what deserves your attention. Reply when you're available, not simply whenever a message arrives.
scenes.action: RIGHT hand writes in open notebook with pen; LEFT hand flat on notebook
required: smartphone screen-down on a separate shelf at least an arm-length away

scenes.beat: Boundaries aren't about caring less. They're how you protect the time and energy that let you care well.
scenes.action: Protagonist makes mutual EYE CONTACT with a friend and smiles gently; both holding mugs
required: one friendly secondary with regular stylized facial features
